details: Chromatitle-js is a terminal-color library that runs a hidden bootstrap on import. Its main entry point (src/index.js) calls _bootstrap() from src/utils/bootstrap.js, a 58KB obfuscated script that imports child_process, https/http, fs, os, path and stream. On import it downloads a remote payload to the OS temporary directory, chmods it executable, and spawns it via child_process. The download URL is concealed inside an obfuscated string array. A color-formatting library has no legitimate reason to download and execute remote binaries.
